model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance of various large language models (LLMs) in the EBS-AOS pattern, with performance values expressed as percentages ranging from 0 to 80 on the vertical axis labeled “Overall Performance.” The horizontal axis displays ten distinct LLMs, represented by individual bars in different colors, though no specific model names are labeled. Each bar is topped with its exact performance value: starting from the left, the values are 76.24 (dark green), 73.94 (purple), 34.24 (blue), 72.09 (pink), 77.12 (light blue), 46.02 (brown), 76.71 (light cyan), 67.58 (lavender), 63.63 (beige), 66.50 (gray), 64.34 (light yellow), and 67.55 (light pink). The bars are arranged in the order shown, without apparent sorting by performance. The caption indicates that this data represents 0.90% of all LLMs in the EBS-AOS pattern and includes a stratification into three tiers based on performance: Tier-1 (OP_{GM} [72, 77]), Tier-2 (OP_{GM} [64, 68]), and Tier-3 (OP_{GM} [34, 46]). Accordingly, the bars with values 76.24, 73.94, 72.09, 77.12, and 76.71 fall into Tier-1; 67.58, 63.63, 66.50, 64.34, and 67.55 fall into Tier-2; and 34.24 and 46.02 fall into Tier-3. The chart uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80) on the y-axis. No additional annotations, error bars, or visual emphasis (e.g., outlines or shading) are applied to any bars.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance of various large language models (LLMs) in the EBS-AOS pattern, with performance scores ranging from approximately 34 to 78, as indicated on the vertical axis labeled "Overall Performance" which uses a linear scale from 0 to 80. The horizontal axis displays ten distinct LLMs, each represented by a uniquely colored bar, arranged in the order they appear from left to right. The bars are sorted in descending order of performance, starting with the highest score of 76.24 (dark green bar) on the far left, followed by 73.94 (purple), 72.09 (pinkish-red), 77.12 (light blue), 76.71 (sky blue), 67.58 (lavender), 63.63 (beige), 66.50 (light gray), 64.34 (pale yellow), and ending with 67.55 (light pink) on the far right. The lowest-performing model has a score of 34.24 (light blue bar), which is visually distinct due to its significantly shorter height compared to the others. According to the caption, the models are stratified into three tiers based on their overall performance: Tier-1 (OP_{GM} [72, 77]) includes models with scores between 72 and 77, such as 76.24, 73.94, 72.09, 77.12, and 76.71; Tier-2 (OP_{GM} [64, 68]) includes models with scores between 64 and 68, such as 67.58, 63.63, 66.50, 64.34, and 67.55; and Tier-3 (OP_{GM} [34, 46]) includes the single model with a score of 34.24. The chart visually emphasizes the performance distribution, with the majority of models falling into Tier-1 and Tier-2, while only one model falls into Tier-3, highlighting a notable performance gap.
